text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
F-Finally done~~. Like, are pop quizzes 
seriously even necessary in this world?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: 'Sup! You guys just finish testing too?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We had two subjects back-to-back. 
Seriously brutal...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Wait, for real?! Props to you guys for 
surviving that!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
At this point, we totally gotta treat 
ourselves, right? Let's just hang out and 
have a blast today! C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
These nail tips would look so good on you, 
Jordan! Look, the gradient is gorgeous, 
and the white stones match the silver 
lines super well♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fr? Whoa, aren't these way too good?? 
Wait, the pink ones are totally viable 
too. Hmm... Guess I'm buying both!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hey, City! Wouldn't that black beret be 
great? You said you wanted one that fits 
high-fashion looks. It'd match that outfit 
you wore in the magazine, too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not bad. The silhouette's clean, and 
it could swing either sweet or streetwear— 
Pairing it with that bag over there works 
too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, alright. Maybe I'll splurge a bit 
today too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whew. Like, somehow... my bad mood just 
totally vanished.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
After grinding through tough tasks, you 
gotta hit mind-reset immediately! Keeps 
motivation high♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally feel ya. ...Oh. Isn't that our 
merch over there?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Looks like there's a bunch 
of new stuff. ...Heh, these plushies 
capture our features pretty well, don't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I've seen that can badge before! It's 
the one that fan who showed me their 
racing silks-inspired concept bag was 
wearing~!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that fan! They also uploaded concept 
nails and oshi makeup to UmaTok, right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yup. Coming up with everything from 
scratch is seriously insane.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Since there aren't many official merch 
drops for apparel and cosmetics like that, 
people usually gotta DIY it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Some of my fans do that too, but it's not 
something just anyone can pull off. 
Everyone's passion is incredible...

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
It feels like an oshi activity only people 
with that skillset can enjoy. ...Hmm, but 
that's kinda a missed opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A crowd has gathered in a corner of the 
cafeteria. ...What could be going on?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da! Let's drop a full line of 
officially licensed everyday concept 
merch~♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Yup! So anyone can easily enjoy stylish 
oshi vibes, I reached out to a bunch of 
different companies♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Over on this table are Horse Girl motif 
cosmetics, and over there are prototypes 
of apparel inspired by racing silks!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, seriously! There's one for me and 
City too~!!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Omg, they're all so cute... Like, I kinda 
wanna buy the other girls' stuff too!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, aren't these cosmetics amazing?? 
Also, I totally recognize this brand!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna use something, you'd want 
your favorite brand, right? I made sure to 
cover all the trending spots♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Not bad. Once these go on sale, I'm 
definitely buying some too.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Right~? The project is already rolling, so 
look forward to it♪
choice_data_list: ...Merch like this is a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well, taking action the second you think 
it'll work is the secret to project 
success, after all♪
choice_data_list:
That's certainly true... Wishing you 
success.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Thanks♪ Once we hit the press release 
stage, we'll promote it on social media 
and short videos, and—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
We'll help out too! Word-of-mouth is gyaru 
territory, right?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Let's all hype up the project and 
make it a massive hit♪

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Once you ditch fixed ideas like 
'merch has to be like this', you can 
create brand new markets♪
choice_data_list:
You're right, I definitely had 
preconceived notions.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I got a reply from an overseas brand 
too. Looks like we can take this global!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Overseas?! That's way too fast...!!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
But there's definitely demand for it, 
right? Stay tuned for updates♪
